title: ESQC mathematics exercises
text:
Preface
This is a stripped-down copy of the Physical Chemistry Quarto book, ready to use as the starting point for a new book or course compendium. The fonts, callouts, light and dark themes, and output settings are already in place.
Replace this page with your own preface or course description. The title, author, cover, and chapter list live in _quarto.yml.






Learning-goalsLearning Goals




Find the main layout and typography settings.
Render the book as HTML and EPUB.









PreparationsPreparations



Install Quarto 1.9.38 or newer. The extensions and fonts are included in this folder.








FactA representative equation



For a harmonic oscillator, the vibrational energies are
\[
E_\nu=\hbar\omega\left(\nu+\frac{1}{2}\right),
\qquad
\omega=\sqrt{\frac{k}{\mu}}.
\]








VisualizationVisualization app

title: 2  Recommended exercises per topic
text:
Second quantization

Binomial expansion
binomial coefficients
Pascal’s triangle
Cauchy product of series
Proof by induction (or direct)
Handling summation signs (also in combination with Kronecker deltas)
Definition of exp as a power series
Partial derivatives of vectors (CI eigenvalue problem)
Finding eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a 2x2 matrix.

SCF

Matrix algebra: matrix multiplication, unitary transformation

DFT

functional derivatives
Transformation formula for multidimensional integrals (calculating Jacobi determinant for transformation from one set of coordinates to another).

Response theory

BCH expansion, manipulation of exponentials of operators.
Exponential of antihermitian operator is unitary (and maybe also the opposite: Every unitary can be written as an exponential of an antihermitian operator).
Poles and residues of complex functions
Fourier transform
exponential form of the sin and cos functions
Euler’s formula for complex exponentials
Partial derivatives with respect to dependent variables (In this case: the parameters Pn and their complex conjugates Pn∗)

Relativity

Levi-Civita symbol
Roots of a 3rd order polynomial

Coupled cluster

Taylor expansion

Molecular properties

Writing cross product in terms of Levi-Civita symbols
Evaluating commutator of momentum operator with a local operator (like vector potential)
Lagrange multiplier method
Total and partial derivatives 

Multiconfigurational methods

resolution of the identity, projection operators
